scope: Reconcile task evidence metadata with the latest task state when an attachment upload overlaps task completion.
defect: An upload started before completion could commit after the task was completed and keep a null completion timestamp from stale component props.
change: At final state commit, read the current task and stamp each new evidence row with its current completedAt value; retain current actor, permission, closed-period, duplicate-ID, and three-file guards.

regression.scenario: Complete a task while the mocked IndexedDB write is pending, then resolve the write and assert the evidence row and task reference use the completion timestamp from the current task state.

validation.browserRaceReproduction: Not run; the asynchronous overlap is covered by the focused component regression. Existing Edge backup and evidence quota journeys predate this small reconciliation change.
